body.text: 測試是可以重複執行的證據：找錯、改程式時的安全網，也是寫成程式的規格。
教師提示：可以問學生：第 4 週的 BankAccount 改過幾次？每次改完怎麼確定沒弄壞其他功能？引出「回歸錯誤」與「安全網」。也提醒：測試只能證明有錯，不能證明沒有錯，沒測到的情況仍可能出錯。

assert：測試的最小單位

assert 條件, 訊息：條件為真就繼續；為假就拋出 AssertionError。

book = GradeBook()
book.add("A001", 59)
book.add("A002", 60)
assert book.passed() == ["A001", "A002"]
直接用 python 執行，錯誤訊息的最後只有：
只知道「錯了」，不知道 passed() 實際回傳什麼；測試框架會補上這些資訊
用 python -O 執行時，所有 assert 都會被略過
所以 assert 只用在測試；檢查輸入要用 if 加 raise（如 GradeBook.add）

def test_average_of_two_scores():
    book = GradeBook()          # Arrange 準備：建立物件與資料
    book.add("A001", 80)
    book.add("A002", 90)
    result = book.average()     # Act 執行：呼叫要測的方法
    assert result == 85         # Assert 驗證：比對預期結果
一個測試只驗證一件事，測試名稱說明這件事。

body.text: pytest 在匯入測試模組時改寫其中的 assert，記下兩邊運算式的值

# tests/conftest.py
@pytest.fixture
def book() -> GradeBook:
    gradebook = GradeBook()
    gradebook.add("A001", 80)
    gradebook.add("A002", 90)
    return gradebook
測試函式的參數名稱就是要用的 fixture，pytest 會自動建立並傳入
預設每個測試都重新建立一次，和 setUp 一樣保持獨立
寫在 conftest.py 的 fixture，同資料夾的測試檔不必 import 就能使用

def test_csv_round_trip(book: GradeBook, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "scores.csv"
    book.save_csv(path)
    loaded = GradeBook.load_csv(path)
    assert loaded.score_of("A002") == 90
    assert len(loaded) == 2

body.text: A test is evidence you can run again: it finds bugs, is a safety net when you change code, and is a spec written as code.

Instructor note: Ask students: how many times did the Week 4 BankAccount change? After each change, how did you know nothing else broke? Introduce regressions and the idea of a safety net. Also point out that tests can show that bugs exist, not that there are none; cases you did not test can still fail.

en.title: assert: the smallest unit of a test

body.text: assert condition, message: if the condition is true, continue; if false, raise AssertionError.

book = GradeBook()
book.add("A001", 59)
book.add("A002", 60)
assert book.passed() == ["A001", "A002"]
Run it directly with python, and the error ends with just this:
You only know it is wrong, not what passed() actually returned; a test framework adds that information
With python -O, every assert is skipped
So use assert only in tests; validate input with if and raise (as in GradeBook.add)

en.title: Three parts of a test: AAA

body.text:
def test_average_of_two_scores():
    book = GradeBook()          # Arrange: create the object and data
    book.add("A001", 80)
    book.add("A002", 90)
    result = book.average()     # Act: call the method under test
    assert result == 85         # Assert: compare with the expected result
A test checks one thing, and its name says what that thing is.

en.title: Five properties of good tests: FIRST

rows: Finishes in seconds, so you run it often
Does not depend on other tests' results or order
Test B uses a student added by test A
Same result every run, on every computer
Depends on datetime.now(), random numbers, the network
assert decides; no need to check by eye
Written with the code, or even first
Tests added just before the final deadline

en.title: Which values to test: equivalence classes and boundary values

body.text: Values in the same class behave the same, so one representative is enough; bugs most often appear at the boundaries (> vs. >=).

E         At index 0 diff: 'A002' != 'A001'
E         Right contains one more item: 'A002'
body.label: Output

body.text: pytest rewrites the assert statements in a test module when it imports the module, recording the values on both sides
It rewrites only the test modules it collects; the code under test (gradebook.py) is unaffected
That is why pytest can use a plain assert, while unittest needs methods such as assertEqual

# tests/conftest.py
@pytest.fixture
def book() -> GradeBook:
    gradebook = GradeBook()
    gradebook.add("A001", 80)
    gradebook.add("A002", 90)
    return gradebook
The parameter name of a test function is the fixture it uses; pytest creates it and passes it in
By default it is created anew for every test, keeping tests independent like setUp
Fixtures in conftest.py can be used by test files in the same folder without importing them

def test_csv_round_trip(book: GradeBook, tmp_path: Path) -> None:
    path = tmp_path / "scores.csv"
    book.save_csv(path)
    loaded = GradeBook.load_csv(path)
    assert loaded.score_of("A002") == 90
    assert len(loaded) == 2

rows: A temporary folder for each test (pathlib.Path)
Reads what print outputs during the test
Temporarily replaces attributes or environment variables and restores them after the test

body.text: Tests that read or write files should not use fixed paths: they interfere with each other and leave files behind
When your own fixture needs cleanup, change return to yield; the code after yield is the cleanup

body.text: Each case is a separate test with its own name; one failing case does not affect the others
A table of equivalence classes and boundary values can become the parametrize data as is
match checks the exception message with a regular expression, confirming it failed for the right reason
Floats have rounding errors (0.1 + 0.2 == 0.3 is False), so compare them with pytest.approx and an acceptable tolerance

rows: Run only tests whose names contain average
Rerun only the tests that failed last time

body.text: pytest results: an exception raised in the test function counts as failed; an error while setting up or cleaning up a fixture counts as error.

rows: Fixtures (injected as parameters, cleanup with yield)

ja.title: assert：テストの最小単位

body.text: assert 条件, メッセージ：条件が真なら続行し、偽なら AssertionError を送出します。

book = GradeBook()
book.add("A001", 59)
book.add("A002", 60)
assert book.passed() == ["A001", "A002"]
python で直接実行すると、エラーの最後はこれだけ：
「間違っている」ことしか分からず、passed() が実際に何を返したかは分からない。テストフレームワークがその情報を補う
python -O で実行すると、すべての assert が省略される
そのため assert はテストだけで使い、入力の検証には if と raise を使う（GradeBook.add のように）

ja.title: テストの 3 つの部分：AAA

body.text:
def test_average_of_two_scores():
    book = GradeBook()          # Arrange 準備：オブジェクトとデータを作る
    book.add("A001", 80)
    book.add("A002", 90)
    result = book.average()     # Act 実行：テスト対象のメソッドを呼ぶ
    assert result == 85         # Assert 検証：期待する結果と比べる
1 つのテストは 1 つのことだけを検証し、テスト名でそれを説明します。

    gradebook.add("A002", 90)
    return gradebook

conftest.py に書いた fixture は、同じフォルダのテストファイルから import せずに使える
